techParks.name: UB City
techParks.description: Bengaluru's flagship CBD development (completed 2008, >1.6 million sq ft) with four office towers - UB Tower, Canberra, Concorde and Comet/Kingfisher - over The Collection luxury mall; home to the UB/Diageo spirits HQs and several strategy and audit firms.

techParks.name: Prestige Trade Tower
techParks.description: Prestige's tallest CBD office tower on Palace Road, anchored by Deloitte (OSM names the building 'Prestige Deloitte') with The Executive Centre serviced offices.

techParks.name: Prestige Khoday Tower
techParks.description: Grade-A office tower at 5 Raj Bhavan Road next to Cubbon Park; OSM records The Executive Centre and Frauscher Sensor Technology as tenants.

techParks.name: Raheja Towers
techParks.description: 1990s twin office block at 26-27 MG Road; OSM mappers record Standard Chartered's branch, Regus, HCL Infosystems, JSW Steel and several insurers here.

techParks.name: Barton Centre
techParks.description: Older mixed-use office block at 84 MG Road; mainly small professional firms, no large anchor tenant could be verified.

techParks.name: Prestige Meridian
techParks.description: Pair of office towers at 29-30 MG Road; historically Citibank's Bengaluru branch (now Axis Bank after the 2023 consumer-business sale) and a cluster of OSM-recorded insurers and mutual funds.

techParks.name: Embassy Square
techParks.description: Embassy Group office building at 148 Infantry Road beside Embassy Point and Embassy Icon; no tenant could be verified in this run.

techParks.name: The Estate
techParks.description: Office building at 121 Dickenson Road off MG Road; OSM records Havells India, ACC, Mitsubishi Elevators and Razorfish among its tenants (unverified).

techParks.name: Prestige Nebula
techParks.description: Office building at 12 Queen's Road / Cubbon Road, part of the Prestige cluster around Minsk Square; no tenant verified in this run.

techParks.name: Prestige Obelisk
techParks.description: Office tower at 3 Kasturba Road opposite Cubbon Park; OSM records JSA, Livspace, Indeed, Infor, Rockwell Automation, Allergan and ICICI Venture here.

techParks.name: Prestige Centre Point
techParks.description: Office building at 7 Cunningham Road; no tenant verified in this run.

techParks.name: Prestige Minsk Square
techParks.description: Prestige's newest CBD office building at Municipal No. 6 Cubbon Road; Apple India's registered office since it left UB City.

techParks.name: Vigyan
techParks.description: Standalone office building at 9 Lavelle Road long occupied by Microsoft India (R&D).

techParks.name: SKAV 909
techParks.description: Boutique office building on Lavelle Road; OSM records MiQ, athenahealth, Awfis and (formerly) Bain and Tesla India here.

techParks.name: Khanija Bhavan
techParks.description: State-owned office block at 49 Race Course Road housing Mysore Minerals, Trigent Software's HQ, an ABB research presence and the Bengaluru Arbitration Centre.

techParks.name: Marksquare
techParks.description: Office building at 61 St Mark's Road shared by EY (3rd-4th floors) and Trilegal (6th-7th floors).

techParks.name: Prestige Sterling Square
techParks.description: Small Prestige office building off Lavelle Road; OSM records Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas and Nexus Venture Partners.

techParks.name: Prestige Emerald
techParks.description: Office building at Municipal No. 2 Madras Bank Road; OSM records Mitsubishi Electric India and Shimizu Corporation.

techParks.name: Prestige Falcon Tower
techParks.description: Office tower at 19 Brunton Road off MG Road; Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas's Bengaluru office.

techParks.name: Prestige Loka
techParks.description: Office building at 202 Brunton Road; OSM records SatSure, KaleidEO and DSK Legal.

techParks.name: Mittal Tower
techParks.description: Older office tower at 47/6 MG Road near Trinity Circle; HSBC's MG Road branch is recorded by OSM just beside it. No large tenant verified.

techParks.name: IndiQube Symphony
techParks.description: Managed-office building at 25 MG Road operated by IndiQube; Khaitan & Co occupies three floors of Tower 2.

techParks.name: Purva Premiere
techParks.description: Office building at 135 Residency Road; Unisys's Bengaluru centre per OSM.

techParks.name: Prestige Central
techParks.description: Office building at 36 Infantry Road; WeWork India's registered office and Infantry Road centre.

techParks.name: WeWork Galaxy
techParks.description: Former Galaxy cinema site at 43 Residency Road, rebuilt as a WeWork flagship and the CBD's best-known startup coworking address.

techParks.name: The Pavilion
techParks.description: Office building at 62/63 Church Street run as a WeWork centre.

techParks.name: Embassy Quest
techParks.description: Embassy office building on Magrath Road operated as a WeWork centre.

techParks.name: Embassy Point
techParks.description: Embassy Group's original corporate-office building at 150 Infantry Road (the group has since moved its HQ to Pinnacle Tower, Hebbal).

techParks.name: Embassy Icon
techParks.description: Embassy office building on Infantry Road beside Embassy Point; no tenant verified in this run.

techParks.name: RMZ Millenia
techParks.description: RMZ's twin-tower campus at the eastern edge of the CBD by Ulsoor Lake; RMZ Corp's own head office and PwC India's Bengaluru client office.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Windsor
techParks.description: Office building at 3 Ulsoor Road; Sattva Group's corporate office.

coverageNotes: WebSearch quota was exhausted for every agent in this run, so verification relied on companies' own pages fetched directly (WebFetch) plus the OpenStreetMap office/landuse extracts and Nominatim/Photon; many corporate sites blocked fetches (403/404/503), and each such case is marked low or medium. CONFIRMED FROM PRIMARY PAGES: BCG (UB City Canberra B), Bain (Anand Bhavan, Vittal Mallya Rd), EY (UB City Canberra, Marksquare, Divyasree Chambers, Prestige Shantiniketan), KPMG (EGL + RMZ Ecoworld - no CBD office), Cushman & Wakefield (EGL), Cyril Amarchand (Prestige Falcon Tower), Trilegal (Marksquare), Khaitan (IndiQube Symphony), Apple (Prestige Minsk Square registered office), Microsoft IDC (BLR Ferns), Diageo/United Spirits (UB Tower), Canara Bank HO (112 JC Road), BEML Soudha, Puravankara, Sattva, RMZ, Embassy Group (now Hebbal), WeWork India (Prestige Central), smallcase (Le Parc Richmonde), Groww (Vaishnavi Tech Park, Bellandur - not Vasanth Nagar), Titan (Electronic City corporate office). OSM-ONLY OR PUBLISHED-ADDRESS-WITHOUT-FETCH (low/medium): Deloitte at Prestige Trade Tower (OSM names the building 'Prestige Deloitte'), PwC at RMZ Millenia, McKinsey (OSM node on Church Street; mckinsey.com 503 x4), Microsoft at Vigyan, 3M at UB City Concorde, Shardul Amarchand (Sterling Square), JSA/Livspace/Indeed (Prestige Obelisk), Unisys (Purva Premiere), MiQ/athenahealth (SKAV 909), Rakuten (Bagmane Pallavi Towers), Mitsubishi Electric (Prestige Emerald), ABB and Trigent (Khanija Bhavan), TCS (SJM Towers), HAL corporate office (Cubbon Road), MSIL, SBI LHO, ICICI Bank Towers, Standard Chartered (Raheja Towers), HSBC (MG Road), SatSure (Prestige Loka), IndiQube/Awfis/Regus/TEC centres. LEFT OUT: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, UBS/Credit Suisse, Citi, Google, Uber, Airbnb, Rolls-Royce, Airbus, Bosch, Wipro, TVS and Hitachi Energy - none has a verifiable CBD office (Citi's MG Road branch became Axis Bank in 2023; Airbus/Google are in Whitefield/ORR; Hitachi Energy's registered office is Brigade Opus, Hebbal); they belong to other lenses. Vijaya Bank's 41/2 MG Road head office was dropped because the merger into Bank of Baroda (2019) predates the 2023 cut-off and no current zonal-office address could be verified. Tesla India's 2021 Lavelle Road registered office (OSM POI at SKAV 909) was dropped as its current status is unknown. Prestige Atlanta (named in the lens as CBD coworking) is actually a WeWork in Koramangala 1st Block, so it is not listed as a CBD park. VC firms (3one4, Nexus, Accel, Peak XV) recorded by OSM in the CBD were left out because none of the four categories fits them. Tenant lists for Barton Centre, Embassy Square, Prestige Nebula, Centre Point and Mittal Tower could not be verified and are empty or OSM-derived. Headcounts were not stated by any fetched source, so every bengaluruEmployeesApprox is null.
